Maximum duration of conditional supplier release, and maximum extension

statements.text_en: This policy defines who may approve purchase orders (POs), supplier releases and air-freight spend.
statements.quote: This policy defines who may approve purchase orders (POs), supplier releases and air-freight spend.

statements.text_en: POs delivered to a Soony site require, in addition to the value approval, a booked dock slot released by the site lead. DC-HAM Hamburg: site lead Katrin Jansen, deputy Raj Patel.
statements.quote: POs delivered to a Soony site require, in addition to the value approval, a booked dock slot released by the site lead.

statements.text_en: Unplanned air freight up to EUR 200,000 per calendar month and category is approved by the responsible Category Lead. Above that, CPO approval is required before booking.
statements.quote: Unplanned air freight up to EUR 200,000 per calendar month and category is approved by the responsible Category Lead. Above that, approval by the CPO is required before booking.

statements.text_en: A supplier is released for serial deliveries only after a successful PPAP and written release by the Supplier Quality Lead and the responsible Category Lead.
statements.quote: A supplier is released for serial deliveries only after a successful PPAP and written release by the Supplier Quality Lead and the responsible Category Lead.

statements.text_en: Conditional releases are limited to 90 days from the date of release. POs placed after a conditional release has expired are held in status 'awaiting approval'.
statements.quote: Conditional releases are limited to 90 days from the date of release. POs placed after a conditional release has expired are held in status 'awaiting approval'.

statements.text_en: A conditional release is extended in writing, once and by at most 90 days, by the responsible Category Lead together with the Supplier Quality Lead.
statements.quote: A conditional release is extended in writing, once and by at most 90 days, by the responsible Category Lead together with the Supplier Quality Lead.

statements.text_en: Exceptions must be documented and approved by the Head of Procurement.
statements.quote: Exceptions must be documented and approved by the Head of Procurement.

statements.text_en: Version 3.2, effective 2025-04-01, owner Head of Procurement, reviewed annually.
statements.quote: Version 3.2 · Effective 2025-04-01 · Owner: Head of Procurement · Review: annually

verdict.summary_en: Procurement Policy PP-07 v3.2 (effective 2025-04-01) sets PO approval limits by role (Buyer <50k up to CPO+CFO jointly ≥5M EUR), requires a booked dock slot from the site lead for deliveries to Soony sites (DC-HAM Hamburg: Katrin Jansen, deputy Raj Patel), sets air-freight approval thresholds (Category Lead up to EUR 200,000 per month and category, CPO above), limits conditional supplier releases to 90 days with a single extension of at most 90 days, and requires Head of Procurement approval for exceptions.
observations: Single-page, fully printed, typed document; no handwriting, stamps, signatures or corrections.
Limit table boundaries: Chief Procurement Officer '< 5,000,000' and CPO and CFO jointly '≥ 5,000,000'; all tiers readable.
Document is a policy and contains no order lines or inspection results; the 'lines' entries record policy thresholds.
